effectSummary.ko: 표식 대상에게 일반 액티브가 처음 직접 적중하면 자원 2를 회복합니다. 시전당 1회, 1초 간격입니다.
effectSummary.en: The first direct normal-active hit against a marked target restores 2 resource. Once per cast, with a 1s interval.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original HELLSCRIPT dark gothic skill icon, a single isolated coherent symbolic subject. Output MUST be a square 1024x1024 PNG with NATIVE fully transparent RGBA alpha; preserve alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty gaps fully transparent. No scenery, opaque or gradient backdrop, checkerboard pattern, floor, plinth, UI panel, frame, border, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark or cast shadow. Main subject AND all effect wisps entirely within x=130..894,y=130..894 (central 76%), generous clean transparent margin on all four sides. Large bold shapes readable at 64x64, restrained details, crisp silhouette, painterly hand-painted dark fantasy materials: worn iron, aged leather, coarse brush texture, deep charcoal shading, sharp ivory and muted gold edge highlights. Match equipment-art chiaroscuro; avoid flat vector lines, glossy cartoon finish and photographic background. Original composition, do not copy any existing game icon. 
Skill: WP07 Brand Pursuit (passive). Gameplay meaning: The first direct normal-active hit against a marked target restores 2 resource. Once per cast, with a 1s interval.
Subject and composition: PASSIVE EMBLEM: one armored steel hand with its index finger pointing diagonally toward a single red-hot angular enemy brand. One small warm amber droplet curls back toward the gauntlet from the brand, symbolizing resource reclaimed when hitting the marked foe. Strong narrow pointing-hand silhouette with a clearly separated triangular brand, a quiet recurring combat tendency. No eye, no letters, no circular target or UI frame.

reuseReason.ko: 기존 HUD 아이콘은 256px 평면 도형이므로 이번 회화풍 1024px 원본 규격에 맞지 않습니다.
reuseReason.en: Existing HUD icons are 256px flat symbols and do not meet the requested painterly 1024px master specification.

notes.ko: 가리키는 손, 붉은 낙인과 돌아오는 자원 흐름이 보이며 WP06의 눈과 구별됩니다. 원본과 두 배경에서 잘림·불투명 바탕·눈에 띄는 헤일로가 없음을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: A pointing hand, red brand and returning resource stream are distinct from the eye in WP06. Original and both backgrounds show no visible clipping, opaque backdrop or halo.

compositionRationale.ko: 처형자의 눈(WP06)과 다른 실루엣이 되도록 낙인을 가리키는 손과 돌아오는 자원 방울로 표현했습니다.
compositionRationale.en: A hand pointing at a brand and a returning resource drop distinguish this silhouette from Executioner's Eye (WP06).
